The source record lists the following event dates for this measure: 2026-01-28, 2026-05-07, 2026-06-17, 2026-08-19, and 2026-08-21.

The 2026-Q2 READM-30 measure, “30-day all-cause readmission rate,” is also reported as a percent measure. The source record lists event dates of 2026-02-10, 2026-05-05, 2026-06-26, 2026-09-17, and 2026-12-02.

The available prior-period record for MED-REC in 2026-Q1 reports the same measure name, “Medication reconciliation completion at discharge,” with unit percent. The listed event dates for this record are 2026-02-09, 2026-05-02, 2026-06-13, 2026-08-15, and 2026-09-01.

Taken together, the structured records provide reported values for MED-REC in 2026-Q2 and 2026-Q1, and for READM-30 in 2026-Q2.
